title: Property
subtitle: Name, logo, home page photo, contact details and house rules. Changes apply at once to the guest site, emails and confirmations.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Without a logo the site shows the name's first letter. The PDF uses a PNG copy made automatically.

hero.title: Home page photo
hero.hint: A landscape photo up to 10 MB; it is scaled to at most 2400 px. The home page darkens it so text stays readable. Only use photos you have the right to use.
hero.none: No photo: the home page uses a colour background

form.title: Details and house rules
form.subtitle: Leave a field empty to use the default shown below it.

destinations.title: Destination photos
destinations.subtitle: The photos on the home page's destination cards. A destination is the part of a room's location after the last comma. Changes apply at once.
destinations.noPhoto: no photo of its own: the card uses the first room photo or a drawing
destinations.creditHint: Your own photo: leave the licence empty. CC BY / CC BY-SA photos: fill in author and licence so the card and the credits page show them.
